name: Investment Fund Tax
definition: Tax related to an investment fund order.

FiscalExemption.name: Fiscal Exemption
FiscalExemption.definition: Indicates whether an owner of an investment account may benefit from a fiscal exemption or amnesty for instance for declaring overseas investments.

PercentageOfDebtClaim.name: Percentage Of Debt Claim
PercentageOfDebtClaim.definition: Percentage of the underlying assets of the funds that represents a debt and is in the scope of the European directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments (Council Directive 2003/48/EC 3 June).

ExemptionIndicator.name: Exemption Indicator
ExemptionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a tax exemption applies.

InvestmentAccount.name: Investment Account
InvestmentAccount.definition: Investment account for which taxes are specified.

Transaction.name: Transaction
Transaction.definition: Transaction for which the tax is specified.
